caption: The drawing shows a three-legged metal pot with a round, wide, shallow basin. The legs are straight and extend downward from the body of the pot, allowing it to stand upright. Attached to the side of the pot is a long, straight handle ending with a round loop. The pot has a rough, textured surface, depicted in shades of gray with darker areas to suggest shadows and depth. There are also two small, round protrusions or rivets visible on the interior upper wall of the pot. The handle is colored similarly to the pot, mainly gray, and is attached with a visible joint. The object is oriented with the handle pointing towards the right edge of the page. The background is a plain off-white or beige, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the composition. The artist’s signature, "G. Jordan," appears in small letters near the lower left corner of the image.
title: Iron Ladle
